questions.question: Why did the LORD say His people's land was destroyed and scorched like a desert?

answers.text: They forsook His law and did not obey His voice
They lost too many battles to their enemies
They let their fields go unplanted for years

questions.question: The LORD said His people followed their stubborn hearts and went after which false gods?
The LORD said the wise, the strong and the wealthy should not boast in themselves. What should anyone boast in instead?

answers.text: That he understands and knows the LORD
That he keeps every rule perfectly
That he gives more than his neighbors

questions.question: The LORD said the whole house of Israel was uncircumcised in what way?
